question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

There is also an increase in __juvenile__ delinquency
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"juvenile"** refers to a young person or someone who is not yet an adult. It is often used to describe someone who is immature or childish. (किशोर)

 
 
• **Example:** Juvenile behavior is often characterized by impulsiveness and a lack of responsibility.
 
 
 
• **"Adult" **refers to a person who is fully grown or developed, typically someone who is mature and responsible. (वयस्क)
 
 
• **Example: **As an** adult,** you are expected to take responsibility for your actions and decisions.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'juvenile' **is **'adult'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Minor **(अल्प): Refers to someone who is under the age of full legal responsibility.

 
 
• **Example:** As a **minor,** he is not allowed to vote or buy alcohol.
 
 
 
• **Teenage **(किशोरावस्था): Refers to someone who is in their teens, typically between the ages of 13 and 19.
 
 
• **Example:** **Teenage** years are often filled with a lot of emotional and physical changes.
 
 
 
• **Puerile** (बचकाना): Refers to behavior that is childishly silly or immature.
 
 
• **Example:** His **puerile **jokes were not appreciated by the serious audience.
